doctor_diabetes_cost.question: 糖尿病患者产生了多少费用

plan.description: 中间：关联临床记录与费用（跨域个人级 JOIN）
plan.sql: SELECT c.patient_id, c.diagnosis_name, b.amount FROM clinical_records c JOIN billing b ON c.visit_id = b.visit_id WHERE c.record_type = 'diagnosis'

doctor_diagnosis_stats.question: 按诊断结果分类统计患者数

plan.description: 中间：按诊断分类（派生表达式引用诊断列）
plan.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN diagnosis_name LIKE '%糖尿病%' THEN '糖尿病' ELSE '其他' END AS grp, patient_id FROM clinical_records WHERE record_type = 'diagnosis'
